summary: Fixed two crop overlay bugs: (1) Crop drag/resize not working at all — caused by selectPanel passing base._cropInteraction (always undefined) instead of this._cropInteraction. Fixed in createCollageMethods.js. (2) Crop drag/resize required two clicks on first panel selection — caused by cropInteraction.setPanelId() running synchronously before Vue rendered the v-if block containing the crop canvas. Fixed by moving setPanelId into $nextTick alongside _scheduleCropPreviewRender in createCropHandlers.js. All 687 unit tests and E2E tests pass.
key_decisions: Changed base._cropInteraction to this._cropInteraction in createCollageMethods.js
Moved cropInteraction.setPanelId into $nextTick in createCropHandlers.js to match the existing pattern for _scheduleCropPreviewRender
challenges: The DOM timing issue was already documented in a previous learning but only the render call was fixed — the interaction attach call had the same problem
